newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Rockapetta to place 48 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Rockapetta to place 48 mln new shares.

text.p: Musical toys maker Rockapetta Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it has agreed to place 48 million new shares, or 16.66 percent of its enlarged share capital, to independent private investors at HK$0.38 per share.
The company said net proceeds of about HK$18 million would be used to repay debt and for working capital.
On completion of the deal on January 22, the stake held by Rockapetta's controlling shareholder Victory Wall Enterprises Ltd will be diluted to 49.21 percent from 59.05 percent.
Rockapetta shares were untraded at HK$0.39 at midday on Tuesday.
